entry.title: New: Resolution 341 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
CREATES ONE NEW PERMIT SYSTEMS COORDINATOR POSITION AND ONE NEW FACILITIES PROGRAM MANAGER POSITION FOR THE DEPARTMENT OF PUBLIC WORKS

Establishes two new positions to (1) maintain the EPIC permitting system and (2) manage the Building Division’s Design and Engineering, General Services, and Repair and Maintenance sections.

Latest action: Council: Adopts Res. 341-23 & FC-110 - 12/06/23
